ucs.title: [LLM] Famous Chollima 'Contagious Interview' — node.exe (BeaverTail) spawning python/curl to stage InvisibleFerret
ucs.description: Hunts the BeaverTail→InvisibleFerret execution chain delivered through trojanized npm packages and fake-interview coding tests. When a developer runs the package, node.exe (the npm postinstall context) spawns python/curl/powershell to fetch the second-stage Python RAT (InvisibleFerret) and to touch browser credential stores — a sequence near-uniquely tied to DPRK's Famous Chollima (CrowdStrike) / UNC4034 / DEV#POPPER (Securonix) / 'Contagious Interview' (Palo Alto Unit 42).
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="node.exe" AND Processes.process_name IN ("python.exe","pythonw.exe","python3.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where match(parent_process,"(?i)(node_modules|postinstall|npm[\\\\ ]+(install|ci|run))") OR match(process,"(?i)(pip[\\\\ ]+install|pyinstaller|requests|Login\\sData|Cookies|AppData\\\\Local\\\\Google|Profiles|AnyDesk)")
| stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(process) as cmdlines values(process_name) as children dc(process_name) as child_variety by host user parent_process
| where child_variety >= 1
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
// Famous Chollima — BeaverTail (node) staging InvisibleFerret (python) + browser cred theft
let Lookback = 14d;
let SuspChildren = dynamic(["python.exe","pythonw.exe","python3.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe"]);
let CredArtifacts = dynamic([@"Login Data","Cookies",@"\Google\Chrome\User Data",@"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data",@"\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles","AnyDesk","pip install","pyinstaller","node_modules","postinstall"]);
let ProcChain =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "node.exe"
    | where FileName in~ (SuspChildren)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (CredArtifacts)
       or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("postinstall","npm install","npm ci","npm run","node_modules")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage = FolderPath, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildSHA256 = SHA256;
let BrowserCredTouch =
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node.exe","python.exe","pythonw.exe")
    | where FileName in~ ("Login Data","Cookies","Web Data","key4.db","logins.json")
       or FolderPath has_any (@"\Chrome\User Data",@"\Edge\User Data",@"\Firefox\Profiles")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              TouchedFile = strcat(FolderPath, "\\", FileName),
              CredAccessor = InitiatingProcessFileName;
ProcChain
| union BrowserCredTouch
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            Signals = make_set(pack("Child",ChildImage,"Cmd",ChildCmd,"File",TouchedFile))
            by DeviceName, AccountName
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Famous Chollima — BeaverTail (node) staging InvisibleFerret (python) — Sentinel
let Lookback = 14d;
let SuspChildren = dynamic(["python.exe","pythonw.exe","python3.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentBin = tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| extend ChildBin  = tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| where ParentBin =~ "node.exe"
| where ChildBin in~ (SuspChildren)
| where Account !endswith "$"
| where CommandLine has_any ("pip install","http://","https://","AnyDesk","Login Data","Cookies","node_modules","postinstall","pyinstaller","requests","Profiles")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: BeaverTail node.exe Spawning Python/Curl (Famous Chollima Contagious Interview)
id: 5b3a9f80-7c2e-4b39-9ec2-famouschollima01
status: experimental
description: Detects node.exe spawning python, curl, wget or PowerShell with arguments characteristic of the BeaverTail JavaScript stager fetching and executing the InvisibleFerret Python RAT — the canonical DPRK 'Contagious Interview' chain.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/dprk-contagious-interview/
  - https://www.securonix.com/blog/analysis-of-dev-popper-new-attack-campaign-targeting-software-developers/
author: SOC Detection Eng
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.007
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.t1555.003
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_node:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\node.exe'
  child_susp:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\pythonw.exe'
      - '\python3.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
  context_tokens:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'pip install'
      - 'pyinstaller'
      - 'requests'
      - 'Login Data'
      - 'Cookies'
      - 'AnyDesk'
      - 'node_modules'
      - 'postinstall'
      - 'AppData\\Local\\Google'
      - 'Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles'
  condition: parent_node and child_susp and context_tokens
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate Electron / node-gyp builds invoking python for native module compilation (filter by build server hostnames)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\node.exe OR *\\Node.exe OR *\\NODE.EXE) @Image:(*\\python.exe OR *\\Python.exe OR *\\pythonw.exe OR *\\PythonW.exe OR *\\curl.exe OR *\\Curl.exe OR *\\wget.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe) @CommandLine:(*pip\ install* OR *pyinstaller* OR *"Login Data"* OR *Cookies* OR *AnyDesk* OR *node_modules* OR *postinstall* OR *Profiles*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^node\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(python|pythonw|python3|curl|wget|powershell|pwsh|cmd)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(pip\\s+install|pyinstaller|Login\\s+Data|Cookies|AnyDesk|node_modules|postinstall|\\\\Profiles\\\\|AppData\\\\Local\\\\(Google|Microsoft\\\\Edge|Mozilla))", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName], function={ count() | min(@timestamp) | max(@timestamp) | collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData]) })
| _count >= 1
ucs.rationale: BeaverTail is JavaScript run inside node.exe via npm postinstall; it specifically drops Python (InvisibleFerret) and immediately pivots to Chrome/Edge/Firefox/keychain credential stores. The parent==node + child∈{python,curl} + browser-cred-string combination is publicly documented as the Contagious Interview chain (Unit 42, Securonix DEV#POPPER, Phylum) and is uniquely Famous Chollima — no benign

ucs.title: [LLM] Famous Chollima DPRK IT-worker — multi-RMM stacking + tunneling client + anonymizing-proxy sign-in on a developer endpoint
ucs.description: Hunts the 'Wagemole' / Nickel Tapestry tradecraft where DPRK operatives, hired as remote engineers under stolen US identities, install several remote-access tools (AnyDesk + RustDesk + Chrome Remote Desktop is the published combo) and a tunneling client (ngrok / cloudflared / localxpose) on the company laptop, then drive it from a US 'laptop farm' IP while their interactive AAD sign-in originates from a commercial VPN/anonymizing proxy.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count values(Processes.process_name) as rmm_tools min(_time) as firstSeen max(_time) as lastSeen
  from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
  where Processes.process_name IN ("AnyDesk.exe","RustDesk.exe","TeamViewer.exe","TeamViewer_Service.exe","ChromeRemoteDesktopHost.exe","remoting_host.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","splashtop.exe","SRService.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe","localxpose.exe","tvnserver.exe")
  by host Processes.user
| eval rmm_count=mvcount(rmm_tools)
| where rmm_count >= 2
| rename Processes.user as user
| join type=inner user [
    | tstats summariesonly=true count values(Authentication.src) as suspect_src values(Authentication.src_category) as src_cat
      from datamodel=Authentication
      where Authentication.action="success" AND Authentication.app IN ("Azure Active Directory","AzureActiveDirectory","Office365")
        AND (Authentication.src_category="anonymizing_proxy" OR Authentication.src_category="hosting_provider" OR Authentication.src_category="vpn")
      by Authentication.user
    | rename Authentication.user as user
  ]
| table host user rmm_tools rmm_count suspect_src src_cat firstSeen lastSeen
| convert ctime(firstSeen) ctime(lastSeen)
ucs.kql:
// Famous Chollima IT-worker — RMM stacking + tunneler + anonymizing-proxy AAD sign-in
let Lookback = 30d;
let RMMBins = dynamic(["AnyDesk.exe","RustDesk.exe","TeamViewer.exe","TeamViewer_Service.exe","ChromeRemoteDesktopHost.exe","remoting_host.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","splashtop.exe","SRService.exe","tvnserver.exe"]);
let TunnelBins = dynamic(["ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe","localxpose.exe","frpc.exe","pinggy.exe"]);
let RMMStack =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName in~ (RMMBins) or FileName in~ (TunnelBins)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | summarize RMMTools = make_set(FileName),
                RMMCount = dcountif(FileName, FileName in~ (RMMBins)),
                TunnelCount = dcountif(FileName, FileName in~ (TunnelBins)),
                FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
                by DeviceName, AccountUpn = AccountName
    | where RMMCount >= 2 or (RMMCount >= 1 and TunnelCount >= 1);
let AnonSignIns =
    AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where IsInteractive == true
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | where IsAnonymousProxy == true
       or NetworkLocationDetails has_any ("anonymousIP","namedNetwork")
       or RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high","medium")
    | summarize AnonIPs = make_set(IPAddress), Countries = make_set(Country), Apps = make_set(Application)
                by AccountUpn;
RMMStack
| join kind=inner AnonSignIns on AccountUpn
| extend DeveloperRoleHint = iff(AccountUpn has_any ("dev","eng","swe","sre","platform","infra"), "likely", "unknown")
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, DeviceName, AccountUpn, RMMTools, RMMCount, TunnelCount, AnonIPs, Countries, Apps, DeveloperRoleHint
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Famous Chollima IT-worker — RMM stacking + anonymizing-proxy AAD sign-in (Sentinel)
let Lookback = 30d;
let RMMBins = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","rustdesk.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","chromeremotedesktophost.exe","remoting_host.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","splashtop.exe","srservice.exe","tvnserver.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe","localxpose.exe","frpc.exe"]);
let RMMStack =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend Bin = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where Bin in (RMMBins)
    | where Account !endswith "$"
    | extend Upn = tolower(Account)
    | summarize Tools = make_set(Bin), ToolCount = dcount(Bin),
                FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
                by Computer, Upn
    | where ToolCount >= 2;
let AnonSignIns =
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | where IsInteractive == true
    | where RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high","medium")
         or tostring(NetworkLocationDetails) has_any ("anonymousIP","namedNetwork")
    | extend Upn = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
    | summarize AnonIPs = make_set(IPAddress),
                Countries = make_set(tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)),
                Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName)
                by Upn;
RMMStack
| join kind=inner AnonSignIns on Upn
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, Computer, Upn, Tools, ToolCount, AnonIPs, Countries, Apps
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) @Image:(*\\AnyDesk.exe OR *\\anydesk.exe OR *\\RustDesk.exe OR *\\rustdesk.exe OR *\\TeamViewer.exe OR *\\teamviewer.exe OR *\\ChromeRemoteDesktopHost.exe OR *\\chromeremotedesktophost.exe OR *\\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\\ngrok.exe OR *\\Ngrok.exe OR *\\cloudflared.exe OR *\\Cloudflared.exe OR *\\localxpose.exe OR *\\frpc.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(AnyDesk|RustDesk|TeamViewer(_Service)?|ChromeRemoteDesktopHost|remoting_host|ScreenConnect\.ClientService|splashtop|SRService|tvnserver|ngrok|cloudflared|localxpose|frpc)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function={ count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=tool_count) | collect([ImageFileName], as=tools) | min(@timestamp, as=first_seen) | max(@timestamp, as=last_seen) })
| tool_count >= 2
| join({ #event_simpleName=UserLogon LogonType=/^(2|10)$/ RemoteAddressIP4=*
         | groupBy([UserName], function={ collect([RemoteAddressIP4], as=remote_ips) }) },
       field=UserName, include=[remote_ips])
